The training frames are extended back to 2014-08-22 from a scratch panel built by scripts/backfill_history.py panel and blanked by scripts/backfill_h5_726.py's `established_panel` to the admitted series (SOFR, TGCR, BGCR, IORB; metadata/backfill_posting.json) and the calendar columns.

back_filled_rows.rule: a back-filled row carries the date, SOFR, IORB, TGCR, BGCR and the calendar columns the extended panel computes for it (quarter_end, tax_date, days_to_month_end). Every other cell is blank, and `require_backfilled_admitted` refuses a panel whose back-filled rows carry any other value.
back_filled_rows.settlement_terms_not_fitted: The two settlement terms (net coupon and net bill settlement, sized in USD 100 bn) are not fitted on back-filled rows: a back-filled row has no settlement column (blank, information-set.md back-fill amendment item 4) and the auction records the net is built from start in 2018, so a back-filled pair read as 'no settlement' would teach the model that settlement days are ordinary days.
back_filled_rows.market_holiday_terms_not_fitted: Found while building, before any score: the pinned market holiday table (metadata/market_holidays.json, sha256 in repo_model.data) starts on 2018-01-01, and `month_end` (the month's last two business days) and `post_month_end_window` (the first three business days) are computed from it. They are not fitted on back-filled rows either, the same treatment as the settlement terms. The table is not extended: that is a data decision of hers. `quarter_end` is the extended panel's own calendar column (a weekday rule before 2018, scripts/backfill_history.py), `tax_date` its own column, `dom_19_23` a function of the date.
back_filled_rows.how: A two-stage refit of each lead, in the script. Stage 1 fits the arm's own terms (Huber, ridge 5, settlement terms sized by net, state held at its maximum: scripts' `s3c_announced.ANN_NET_ARM`) with `fit_state_terms` on the pairs whose target row is a published row only; its effects of the four terms of the second group above are kept. Stage 2 fits the three terms known on back-filled rows (quarter_end, tax_date, dom_19_23) with `fit_state_terms` on every pair, back-filled targets included, on the standardised residual net of the stage-1 effects of the four kept terms where the pair's row carries them (a back-filled pair has no such flags and is left as it is). The estimate that forecasts reads the stage-2 effects of the three terms, the stage-1 effects of the four, and the stage-2 pool (the standardised residual after all of them). Both stages train on direct pairs (`training_pairs='direct'`); the one-step guard is not met, no allow-list entry is used or added.
back_filled_rows.consequence: A back-filled settlement or month-end day is not flagged, so its residual stays in the pool and in the quarter-end, tax and day-of-month fits: the pool is wider and those three terms are fitted against an omitted-variable contamination. The measurement includes that cost; it is the price of reading no settlement or holiday information the information set does not admit. Reported beside the result.
